projection.method: Gaussian QR; diagonal R sign fixed; label-independent

task: UCI News Aggregator four-class headline classification
source_split: story/title union components; exclude cross-month, label conflicts and prior five-cohort components; fixed salt
source_only_amendment: Original March allocation needed 80 components per class; only 77 health components remained after strict exclusions. Reduced old/current training and probe counts before Encoder extraction or model outcomes; isolation unchanged.
evaluation_scope: historical time holdouts; no prospective or unseen pretraining claim
retention_target: old probe loss at end of old warmup; translated into time-varying reference-relative coordinates
observation_extension: two probe-gradient inner products with current first optimizer moment
noise_model: deterministic full-batch; Q=0; no stochastic future-path certificate
reference: 24 uncontrolled current-task Adam steps from the same complete old-warmup state
action: add h*B*u to parameter coordinates after Adam; optimizer moments unchanged by this additive action
primary_comparison: loss2 minus myopic declared control cost and final task NLL; separately per mask and head
additional_comparisons: full-state tangent oracle versus field policies
final_labels_access: only after all 60 policy paths, output predictions, checkpoints and pre-evaluation inventory are sealed
failure_policy: retain every registered condition and nonfinite/invalid failure; no tuning from final outcomes
uncertainty: paired source-component bootstrap conditional on fixed fitted models; paired seeds are not independent source observations
resources: separate encoder, warmup, reference/derivatives, policy synthesis, online control, evaluation, state/archive bytes and recovery; energy unknown
registration: locally frozen before experiment outcomes; not independent external preregistration
